title: Blue Book's Robert Friend sees the channeling session; told another agency has it

tellings.quote: And then the general says another agency has it hands off. And we never hear anything more.

plain: A UFO researcher, Grant Cameron, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a July 1959 meeting in Washington, described in an 11-page memo, where people tried to contact beings through channeling, meaning speaking with them through a person in a trance. Cameron says that Robert Friend, an officer from Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, saw the session alongside a man named Arthur Lundahl, but a general then said another agency had the matter, hands off, and nothing more was heard. If true, another part of the government was quietly handling UFO contact while the Air Force study was told to stay out.
